result.topic_en: Draft of Riemann's Latin petition to the Göttingen philosophical faculty for the doctoral degree, submitting his dissertation on the foundations of a general theory of functions of a complex variable, with fee calculations and upside-down German notes below.

items.quote: Speciminis dignitatis dissertationem scripsi, quae in jaciendis fundamentis theoriae generalis functionum complexae quantitatis variabilis [-collocata est-] {+versatur+}.
items.english: As a specimen of worthiness I have written a dissertation which is concerned with laying the foundations of a general theory of functions of a complex variable quantity.
